title: PG Semester Examination Schedule & Hall Tickets
body: The PG Examination timetable for semester examinations has been announced. Students are requested to collect their hall tickets from their respective department offices.

title: Revised UG & PG Fee Payment Deadline
body: Last date for payment of odd semester academic fees without penalty is extended. Check the official fee circular for payment details.

title: Annual Sports Meet & Inter-Collegiate Tournaments
body: Department of Physical Education is organizing the annual university track and field competitions at the University 400M Stadium.

title: Holiday Declaration: Gandhi Jayanti Observance
body: The university administrative offices and constituent departments will observe a holiday. Essential services will remain operational.
